alpaca_docs_consulted.relevant_content: FINRA has approved replacing the legacy PDT framework with an intraday-margin system: the $25,000 equity threshold and the four-trades-in-five-days count are both ELIMINATED, replaced by real-time Intraday Margin Level monitoring. 0DTE long-option expiration is explicitly classified as an IML-reducing transaction. Timeline: a 12-month interim transition period after SEC approval, during which member firms MAY apply either the legacy PDT rules or the new intraday-margin rules, by account or firm-wide.
alpaca_docs_consulted.docs_limitation: The docs describe the forward regulatory regime. They do NOT state what Alpaca PAPER reports for cash-vs-margin, and no doc page was found that explains the absent pattern_day_trader/daytrade_count fields. That absence is an empirical finding from the live API, not a documented behavior.

account_type_question_for_J.the_paragraph_for_J: On today's live broker data safe-2's cash_settlement exemption is the DEFECT and bold-2's margin_pdt is CORRECT. Both core accounts report multiplier=4, max_margin_multiplier=4, shorting_enabled=true and regt_buying_power at 2x equity -- those are RegT margin accounts, not cash accounts, so the legacy FINRA PDT rule (which safe-2's mode switches off entirely) does apply to them, and both sit far under the $25,000 threshold at ~$5.5-5.7K. The 2026-07-14 provenance that justified the exemption ('multiplier 1, cash accounts') is not merely stale: the accounts it was measured on were deleted, and every one of the six replacements built on 2026-08-03 reports margin. Consequence: safe-2 has taken 8 day-trades in the last 5 business days on a sub-$25K margin account and its gate cannot see them, while bold-2 correctly stopped itself at 3 and has sat out four sessions -- which cost a verified $564.90 today alone. This is currently harmless because it is PAPER and Alpaca's paper API does not return pattern_day_trader or daytrade_count at all (so no broker-side enforcement exists either way); it becomes a real compliance exposure the moment GAMMA_CORE_ARMED=1 touches live money, where a real broker would flag safe-2 as a pattern day trader and freeze it. The genuine fork -- and why this is yours, not mine -- is that the two defensible fixes point opposite ways: tighten safe-2 to margin_pdt for correctness and accept that BOTH core arms then jail themselves for days at a time on paper (bold-2's four silent sessions become the norm, not the exception), or leave both loose on paper deliberately to keep collecting evidence and gate the correctness fix to live-arming instead. FINRA has in fact approved eliminating the trade-count rule in favour of intraday-margin monitoring, with a 12-month interim in which firms may apply either regime -- so the constraint bold-2 is currently obeying may not even exist by the time you arm live. I have changed nothing and recommend the second path with an explicit live-arming checklist item, but the call is yours.

new_findings.shape: Poisoned-empty-cache: on ANY fetch exception it sets bars=[] and then writes the cache CSV unconditionally. Every later call sees p.exists() and returns 0 bars forever, with no warning.
new_findings.trigger_proven_live: The hardcoded window end={date}T20:15:00Z (16:15 ET) always falls inside Alpaca's last-15-minutes real-time embargo for a same-day fetch. Alpaca answers HTTP 403 {"message":"OPRA agreement is not signed"}.
new_findings.discriminating_evidence: Same symbol, same key, only the end bound changed: end=20:15:00Z -> HTTP 403; end=19:00:00Z -> 200 OK with 331 bars; end=20:05:00Z -> 200 OK with 396 bars.
new_findings.blast_radius: Hit it live this session -- it silently wrote two 1-line CSVs for SPY260806P00770000 and SPY260806C00769000. Any same-day EOD study run before ~16:30 ET permanently poisons that symbol/date for every later consumer of the shared cache.
new_findings.action_taken: Deleted both poisoned files and refetched with a valid end bound. The CODE IS UNFIXED.
new_findings.note: This is the same family as L241 (a fetcher masking a 403 as 'no data'), but worse: L241's fetcher merely returned nothing, this one PERSISTS the nothing.

new_findings.shape: Confidently-wrong-number: silently omits structure_stop_enabled and trigger_level from ExitState.from_entry, so any shape declaring stop_mode='structure' degrades to premium mode at -20% without any warning. Exit code 0, plausible-looking output.
new_findings.measured_error: safe-2's real trade replayed as -$76.80 (stopped out 10:34 ET) vs broker truth +$338.45. $415.25 error, sign flipped.
new_findings.why_it_matters: params.structure_stop_enabled=true in BOTH params.json and aggressive/params.json, i.e. every live core position since the v15.3 chart-stop-primary build runs structure mode. Any counterfactual built on this helper without the parity check is wrong in the pessimistic direction.
new_findings.action_taken: Worked around locally by passing the structure params explicitly; parity then closed to $8.00 (2.4%). The SHARED HELPER IS UNFIXED.

new_findings.shape: Both emit healed = [bool]$Heal into their status JSON -- a verbatim echo of the -Heal REQUEST switch, not the outcome of any healing. A reader sees "healed": true and infers healing happened when it only means healing was asked for.
new_findings.mitigation_disclosed: Not a gate-logic defect. In both scripts the primary verdict is computed from real node checks, and connectivity-gate additionally emits tv_heal_action which does carry the true outcome. preflight-gate has no such secondary field.
